description: Arithmetic on entered numbers only: level end-of-period withdrawal, total withdrawn and complete period table from a balance, fixed entered nominal annual return and term. Monthly, quarterly or annual periods; nearest-cent half-up rounding; final withdrawal clears residue. Rates are entered, never fetched. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

annualReturnPercent.description: Entered fixed nominal annual return percentage; at most six decimal places, divided by periods per year.

balance.description: Starting balance in USD, at most two decimal places.

frequency.description: Withdrawal timing: 12 monthly, 4 quarterly or 1 annual end-of-period withdrawal per year.

years.description: Whole years; at most 360 monthly, 120 quarterly or 30 annual rows.

name: retirement_drawdown

outputSchema.description: USD startingBalance, withdrawal per period, totalWithdrawn, totalReturn, finalWithdrawal; frequency, periodsPerYear, periods; complete table of period/interest/withdrawal/balance. Exact cents at zero return; all money rounds half up to cents and totals reconcile.
